artifactRequest.question: Explain how grouped cross-validation keeps transformations inside the training folds. Identify the split, fitted preprocessing, estimator, and evaluation flow; inspect implementation before alleging leakage.

claims.summary: Account groups are separated in the holdout and inner folds.
Each target encoder is fit on inner training rows and only transforms inner validation rows.
A fresh encoder and booster fit all training rows before transforming the untouched holdout for final metrics.
Early stopping and prediction behavior depend on CatBoost and scikit-learn APIs outside inspected local source.
The artifact cannot establish CSV contents or actual group and label distributions.

dataOrigin.answer: A CSV is loaded, row-local features are engineered, and complete account groups are held out.

updatedParametersAndFitState.answer: Target encoder maps and CatBoost state fit per fold, then fresh state fits all training rows.

losses.answer: CatBoost Logloss appears only in cited setup and is not a visible workflow node; the workflow emphasizes AUC selection.

evaluationBoundaries.answer: Inner grouped validation selects rounds; an untouched group holdout supplies final metrics.

outputs.answer: The report includes holdout ROC AUC, average precision, CV AUC, and held-out account count.

uncertainty.answer: Coverage states that data distributions and third-party runtime behavior were not observed.
